{{Quote|Markez Moon. Neen Valley. Station Four junction. We leave tomorrow night.|Saw Gerrera feeding false intel to Pluti|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />}}
'''Markez Moon''' was a [[moon]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> in the [[Markez system]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that had a [[Rhydonium]] installation located in the [[Neen Valley]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> 

In [[3 BBY]]<ref name="GhormanDate">{{AndorDate|205}}</ref> [[Saw Gerrera]] fed false intel to a mole working for the [[Galactic Empire]] within his [[Partisans|rebel cell]] by telling [[Pluti]] that the group was going to execute a Rhydonium heist on the moon.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Markez Moon was first mentioned in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
